solutions.title: Shrink candidate prefix
solutions.strategy: Start with the first string and trim it until every string starts with it.

timeComplexity.explanation: Across all trimming and prefix checks, characters from the input strings are compared against the candidate prefix.

spaceComplexity.explanation: The candidate prefix can be as long as the shortest string.

solutions.title: Column-wise scan
solutions.strategy: Compare the same character position across all strings and stop at the first mismatch.

timeComplexity.explanation: At most the common-prefix portion of each string is inspected, bounded by total input characters s.

spaceComplexity.explanation: Only indexes are stored aside from the returned substring.
